_doc: fc-single-008 (data): transform_json with the drop_field operation and args {field: 'ssn'} on /data/customers.json. Decoys are read_file and write_file. Tests picking the right operation and args shape from the tool description.
prompt: The file /data/customers.json holds a list of customer records. Drop the 'ssn' field from every record and write the result back to /data/customers.redacted.json.

function.name: transform_json
function.description: Apply a small set of named transforms to a JSON value loaded from disk. Returns the transformed value as a JSON string. `operation` is one of: 'rename_field' (rename a top-level field — args: {"from": "old_name", "to": "new_name"}), 'drop_field' (remove a top-level field — args: {"field": "field_name"}), 'project' (keep only a whitelisted set of top-level fields — args: {"fields": ["field_a", "field_b"]}).

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path. Returns the file contents as a UTF-8 string, or an error if the file does not exist or is not readable.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to read, e.g. /etc/hostname

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a UTF-8 string to a file at the given absolute path, overwriting any existing contents.
